title: Recap: *bármi … is* with the subjunctive, and *történjék bármi*

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: You know *bármi … is* and *bármilyen … is* from B2 Unit 4 and the subjunctive in *-jon/-jen* from B1 Unit 3. Together they say that nothing changes whatever happens: `Bármit mondjon is a törvény, …` (Whatever the law may say, …). New in this lesson is the literary `Történjék bármi, …` (Happen what may, …).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The second clause says what stays the same: `Bármilyen új rendeletet hozzon is a hatalom, a polgárok nem hátrálnak meg.` (Whatever new decree the regime may issue, citizens will not back down.)

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: Történjék bármi, a polgárok nem hátrálnak meg.
Happen what may, citizens do not back down.
Bármilyen megtorlással fenyegessen is a hatalom, a polgárok kitartanak.
Whatever reprisals the regime may threaten with, citizens hold out.
Bármilyen új törvényt hozzon is az önkény, a polgárok nem hódolnak be.
Whatever new law despotism may make, citizens will not submit.
